title: NIST WebBook: Ozone is O3, molecular weight 47.9982 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Ozone as O3, molecular weight 47.9982 amu, CAS 10028-15-6.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Ozone, CAS Registry Number 10028-15-6, lists molecular formula O3 and molecular weight 47.9982 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 47.98474385868 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/O3/c1-3-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
